description.value: Manufacturer's properties that describe the rudimentary data of the outlet connection.
Highest value of outlet pressure at which the pump or component is capable of functioning on the basis of the materials used.
Lowest value of outlet pressure at which the pump or component is capable of functioning on the basis of the materials used.

Alphanumeric parameter for reference purposes, referring to a combination of mechanical and dimensional properties of a component of a piping system. It comprises the letters PN followed by a dimensionless number.
Free cross-sectional area of the orifice in the outlet connection of the pump.
Outlet pressure at which the relief valve will pass the total pump flow.
Pressure at the outlet of the relief valve when the valve is closed.
Outlet pressure at which the relief valve will close after passing the total pump flow.
Outlet pressure at which the relief valve begins to open.
Properties that describe the specific installation and operational situation of the outlet connection.
Height of the center of the outlet connection of the pump.
Rated flow at pump outlet connection divided by the inlet area of the pump.

An alphanumeric designation of size for components of a pipework system, which is used for reference purposes. It comprises the letters DN followed by a dimensionless whole number which is indirectly related to the physical size, in millimeters, of the bore or outside diameter of the end connections.
Outlet pressure of the pump at the guarantee point with rated flow and rated speed, as well as rated inlet pressure, for rotodynamic pumps only.
Head observed at outlet area of the pump, corresponding to the sum of the height, pressure head and velocity head.
All measurements of the operation which describe the outlet connection.
Measured rate of flow at pump outlet connection divided by the outlet area of the pump.
Vector quantity giving the rate of change of a position vector
Measured temperature acting at the outlet area of the pump.
Quantity representing a temperature value
Buyer's properties that describe the installation situation of the outlet port.
Pressure at the outlet of a vacuum pump.
